sections.section_title: I3C broadcast/direct RSTACT CCC transfer, as controller
sections.text_helper: Section 64.9.4 "I3C broadcast/direct RSTACT CCC transfer, as controller" in chapter 64 (Improved inter-integrated circuit (I3C)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3197.
sections.section_content:
Figure822 illustrates I3C broadcast (write), direct write and read RSTACT CCC, as
communicated on the I3C bus, and as programmed when acting as controller.
